title: threeFactor engine config
description: Sparse deviations from registry defaults. The execution list is the algorithm order, validated against unit consumes/produces at load. Default config = frozen dev72 behavior.

execution.description: Full unit order; omit to inherit the default order.

phantomTee.description: C01 complete-occlusion fallback: synthesize a missing tee at the predecessor hole's assigned basket tip.

minViableScore.description: a hole whose best assignment score is at or below this counts as tee-less

scoring.description: Tee-badge-basket pair scoring geometry: zone/ring proximity, orientation, collinearity, basket identity.

fallbackTeeBboxOffset.description: fallback tee bbox half-size when no ring/component geometry exists (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee, measure.ts makeTees)

fallbackTeeBboxSize.description: fallback tee bbox dimension (size x size) when no ring/component geometry exists (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee, measure.ts makeTees)

ringDistance.description: basket-to-tee ring membership distance (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee onRing, measure.ts makeTees onRing, scoring.ts zoneFactor primary ring)

ringTolerance.description: tolerance band around ringDistance for the basket-to-tee ring check (shared: assignment.ts, measure.ts, scoring.ts)

zoneFactorDistance.description: close-proximity threshold for the zone factor penalty around a non-owning basket

secondaryRingDistance.description: secondary ring distance for the zone factor radial check

secondaryRingTolerance.description: tolerance band around secondaryRingDistance for the zone factor radial check

radialTolerance.description: radial alignment fraction threshold for the zone factor penalty

teeOrientationSigma.description: gaussian sigma (degrees) for the tee-to-badge angle penalty

badgeFractionTarget.description: optimal fractional position of the badge along the tee-basket chord

badgeFractionTolerance.description: acceptable deviation from badgeFractionTarget before the fraction penalty kicks in

badgeFractionSigma.description: gaussian sigma for the badge-fraction penalty

collinearityWeight.description: upward factor for the collinearity bonus

collinearitySigma.description: gaussian sigma (degrees) for the collinearity angle penalty

basketIdentityFloor.description: minimum score factor for the basket identity prior

basketScoreOffset.description: offset subtracted from basket.score in the basket identity calculation

basketScoreScale.description: divisor for basket.score normalization in the basket identity calculation

zfit.description: Z-shaped route salvage for top-K assignment rows whose corridor support is weak.

topK.description: assignment rows eligible for the salvage re-score (was ZFIT_TOP_K)

alignedWorstCeiling.description: skip salvage when the aligned worst-window support is already at/above this
